positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · OpenAI · Pair Programming

company.name: Future of Work Initiative, powered by Microsoft

positions.title: Summer Program IT Consultant
positions.description:
During my time at TECH-Nique, I was the main consultant for Microsoft's Power Apps platform. 
My job duties included:
• introducing the Power Apps platform to all interns and 
• meeting one-on-one with software engineering interns to work through project development issues. 

On a personal note, this was one of my favorite job experiences, as I had the privilege of watching each team's final projects aiming to solve issues in their community and saw just how much they accomplished during the short summer term.

positions.title: Engineer Co-op/Intern
positions.description:
IT Business Info Platforms
•	Created new ETL packages for the company’s data warehouse
•	Resolved incident and problem tickets involving incorrect data
•	Designed and updated ER diagrams for data requested by client

Generation Engineering
•	Tracked machine instrument tag data which added a new feature to the in-house analytics tool
•	Used Python and Tesseract-OCR to extract text from drawings for keyword lookup tool
•	Created several online reports for upper management

Worked alternating semesters.

positions.title: Student Office Assistant
positions.description:
Worked alternating semesters on campus.

Speed School of Engineering Advising Desk
•	Communicated with walk-in traffic and phone calls 
•	Assisted with directing students to orientation site
•	Trusted to handle and maintain confidential records

projects.title: Capstone Design Final Project
projects.description: Partnership with a healthcare technology business to create an iOS and Android app to inform family or friends about a patient's care.

projects.title: Self-orienting Solar Panel
projects.description: Used Assembly and C programming to create a self-orienting solar panel.
